meta.title: Is Vietnam’s Ba Na Hills WORTH IT ? Scooter Ride to Vietnam's Golden Bridge & Hoi An Ancient Town
meta.description:
Is the famous Golden Bridge in Vietnam actually worth the hype, or is it just a $37 tourist trap? 🇻🇳☁️

In this video, we take a scooter from Da Nang straight into the clouds to explore Ba Na Hills. We ride the world's longest single-track cable car, walk the foggy French Village, and test out the Alpine Coaster to see if the ticket price is justified.

But the mission didn't end there! We raced the sunset to Hoi An Ancient Town to explore the Night Market, see the lanterns, and grab the best Banh Mi for just $1.

We track every single dollar spent to show you exactly how to do this massive day trip on a budget of $55 per person.

In this video, we cover:

🛵 Scooter Rental: How to get from Da Nang to Ba Na Hills cheaply.
🚠 The Cable Car: Riding 6km straight up into the fog.
🖐️ Golden Bridge: Expectations vs. Reality (and the best time to go).
🎢 Fantasy Park: Is the Alpine Coaster included in the ticket?
🏮 Hoi An: Night Market, Lantern Boats, and Food.
💰 Cost Breakdown (Per Person):

Ba Na Hills Ticket: $37
Scooter Rental: ~$6
Food & Coffee: ~$12
Total Day Trip Cost: ~$55
